#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string dna;
    std::cin >> dna;
    int wholeCounter = 0;
    int tempCounter = 1;
    char previousCharacter = dna[0];
    int i = 1;

    while (i < dna.length()) {
        char currentCharacter = dna[i];
        if (currentCharacter == previousCharacter) {
            tempCounter++;
            if (i == dna.length() - 1) {
                if (tempCounter % 2 == 0) {
                    wholeCounter++;
                    tempCounter = 1;
                }
            } else {
                char nextCharacter = dna[i + 1];
                if (nextCharacter != previousCharacter && tempCounter % 2 == 0) {
                    wholeCounter++;
                    tempCounter = 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            previousCharacter = currentCharacter;
        }
        i++;
    }

    std::cout << wholeCounter << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
